messages:
Eli: hi team, day 2. Trying to run CI that calls GCP APIs via `gcloud auth print-access-token --impersonate-service-account=sa-onboard@redwood-onboard-eli.iam.gserviceaccount.com` but get `insufficient permission to impersonate service account`. Who can grant the iam.serviceAccounts.getIamPolicy/iam.serviceAccounts.getAccessToken?
Tara: welcome Eli! You need to be granted the 'Service Account Token Creator' role on the SA (`roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator`). Ops or infra can bind it to your user or the `eng-onboarding` group.
Eli: do we prefer binding the group? I'd rather not add my user permanently.
ops: @Eli yes we prefer `eng-onboarding@redwood.com` group for onboarding SAs. Send the project id and SA email and we'll add the binding.
Eli: project is `redwood-onboard-eli`, SA is `sa-onboard@redwood-onboard-eli.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. Also tried linking billing but `gcloud beta billing projects link` returned PERMISSION_DENIED.
Tara: for billing link finance needs to add `roles/billing.user` to the billing account for the `eng-onboarding` group. Ping `billing-team` and include short justification.
Eli: FYI also got a 403 creating network endpoint in `europe-west4` saying org policy blocks external IPs for that folder. Is there a quick workaround?
ops: not without approval. For onboarding you can use `europe-west1` or `us-central1` which are already allowed. If you need europe-west4 for testing, file a policy exception with the security review.
infra-bot: Note: project redwood-onboard-eli missing billing link; automated sandbox provisioning paused.
Eli: ok will request billing->group and use us-central1 for now. Thanks!
Tara: once billing link/grants are in place ping here and we can finish SA binding and CI test. welcome aboard :tada:
